e.body:
**bandit-risk**（GitHub `m-aghababaie/bandit-risk`，MIT，**2026-09-09 仍在推送**）自述为「**为保险与房产智能而做的多臂老虎机算法**」。可核实信息：**MIT 许可**、**★2、0 fork**、**2026-05-19 创建、2026-09-09 最后推送**、**666 KB**、**Python 3.10+**、`pyproject.toml`、带 CI（GitHub Actions）、black 代码风格；代码结构实测为 **`bandit_risk/agents/`（`epsilon_greedy.py`、`ucb1.py`）+ `bandit_risk/envs/`（`esg_env.py`、`inspection_env.py`、`outreach_env.py`）+ `utils/plotting.py` + `experiments/` + 7 个测试文件**（含 `test_epsilon_greedy.py`、`test_ucb1.py`、三个环境各自的测试）。

**它解决什么问题**（README 原文）：财产险公司要做**成百上千次重复决策**——**用哪种查勘策略**、**推荐哪一项 ESG 改造**、**把资源投在哪条触达渠道**；bandit-risk 把多臂老虎机强化学习用在这些决策上，**从经验中学习策略，而不是用历史平均值**。作者为 Mohammad Aghababaie（Hubbcast / Insurmatics），属其「From Bandits to Buildings」开源系列。

**⭐ 这个项目最值得记录的一点，是它对方法适用性的自我审查**：README 用一整节论证——**多臂老虎机要求「奖励只取决于所采取的动作，而绝不取决于历史、经过时间或演化状态」**；一旦这个条件被破坏，问题其实是**马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）**，bandit 的 regret 保证随即失效。于是它**对每个环境都做这项检验，并主动排除那些经检验属于 MDP 的问题**：保留 `InspectionBanditEnv`（5 臂、最优臂 Full structural、μ=0.70）与 `ESGBanditEnv`（6 臂、最优臂 Heat pump ASHP、μ=0.71），而**主动剔除**「维保排程」（判为 **MDP**）与「传感器事件排序」（判为 **POMDP**），并附专门文档 `docs/genuine_bandits.md` 说明。**结果汇报里也给出了一条真正有信息量的结论**：在查勘问题上有一个策略明显最优，**低探索反而更好**；而在 ESG 问题上**前两名几乎持平，探索不足会卡在次优臂**——所以**「正确」的探索率取决于选项有多难区分**。

对 RIAA：前两轮刚补上**需求侧**（[[choicer]] 估需求曲线、[[pricingbandits]] 边定价边学需求），本轮补的是**决策侧**——**当同一类决策要重复做几千次、且每次都能观察到结果时，用老虎机学习比用历史平均更合适**。对保险学生的实际用处有两层：**①** 检索/查勘/触达这类「高频、可观测反馈」的运营决策，是实习与案例作业里真实存在的场景，而课程通常只教到「算一个平均数」；**② 更重要的是一套判断纪律**——**先问「这到底是不是老虎机」**。这条纪律在保险里格外容易踩坑：**赔付经验、续保与退保、维修排程、客户状态迁移都会让状态随时间演化**，此时套用 bandit 而声称「保证」是错的；这个项目把这一判断**写成可执行的检验并公开剔除案例**，比多收一个算法库有价值得多。相关条目：需求侧见 [[choicer]]、[[pricingbandits]]；费率与运营优化见 [[rate-optimiser]]、[[insurance-optimise]]、[[insurance-uplift]]；ESG 与气候改造场景见 [[esg-generator-python]]、[[esg]]、[[awesome-sustainable-finance]]、[[dfa-climate-datasets]]、[[climate-conditioned-cat]]；车联网与行为数据场景见 [[insurance-telematics]]、[[zenroad-telematics]]；决策与决策过程建模见 [[imaginator]]、[[claims-triage-mcp]]、[[agentic-bop-underwriting]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ★2、0 fork**，尚无社区采用；**② README 的 Install 段写明「**PyPI release coming soon**」、当前需从源码安装（`pip install -e ".[dev]"`），而仓库简介里却写着 `pip install bandit-risk`——**两处不一致**，且**本次实测 PyPI 上查不到该包**；**③** README 的 regret 曲线与「最优臂」数值均为**作者自述**，**未复现**；**④** 环境是**作者构造的合成决策问题**（如 μ=0.70/0.71 的收益分布），**并非真实保险公司数据**。**核实说明**：GitHub 仓库元数据、完整文件树（43 个文件）、README 原文均经 API 实测；**未安装、未运行代码，未复现其 regret 结果**。
e.body_en:
**bandit-risk** (GitHub `m-aghababaie/bandit-risk`, MIT, **still pushed on 2026-09-09**) describes itself as "**multi-armed bandit algorithms for insurance and property intelligence**". Verifiable details: **MIT licence**, **2 stars, 0 forks**, **created 2026-05-19, last pushed 2026-09-09**, **666 KB**, **Python 3.10+**, `pyproject.toml`, CI via GitHub Actions, black code style; the measured structure is **`bandit_risk/agents/` (`epsilon_greedy.py`, `ucb1.py`) plus `bandit_risk/envs/` (`esg_env.py`, `inspection_env.py`, `outreach_env.py`), `utils/plotting.py`, `experiments/` and seven test files** (including `test_epsilon_greedy.py`, `test_ucb1.py` and one test per environment).

**The problem it addresses** (from the README): property insurers make **hundreds of repeated decisions** — **which inspection strategy to deploy**, **which ESG retrofit to recommend**, **which outreach channel to invest in**; bandit-risk applies multi-armed bandit reinforcement learning to these decisions so the policy is **learned from experience instead of from historical averages**. The author is Mohammad Aghababaie (Hubbcast / Insurmatics), and the project is part of his "From Bandits to Buildings" open-source series.

**⭐ Most notable is the project’s self-audit of method applicability.** The README devotes a section to arguing that **a multi-armed bandit requires reward to depend only on the action taken — never on history, elapsed time or evolving state**; the moment that condition breaks, the problem is really a **Markov decision process (MDP)** and bandit regret guarantees no longer hold. It therefore **validates every environment against that test and deliberately excludes those found to be MDPs**: it keeps `InspectionBanditEnv` (5 arms, best arm Full structural, μ=0.70) and `ESGBanditEnv` (6 arms, best arm Heat pump ASHP, μ=0.71) while **excluding** "maintenance scheduling" (judged an **MDP**) and "sensor incident sequencing" (judged a **POMDP**), with a dedicated `docs/genuine_bandits.md` explaining the reasoning. Its reported results also contain a genuinely informative finding: on the inspection problem one strategy clearly dominates, so **low exploration wins**; on the ESG problem **the top two are nearly tied, so too little exploration gets stuck on the second-best arm** — hence **the "right" exploration rate depends on how distinguishable the options are**.

For RIAA: the previous two rounds supplied the **demand side** ([[choicer]] estimating the demand curve, [[pricingbandits]] learning it while pricing); this round adds the **decision side** — **when the same kind of decision is repeated thousands of times and each outcome is observable, learning with a bandit beats averaging history**. Two practical uses for students: **①** operational decisions like inspection, investigation and outreach are "high-frequency, observable-feedback" problems that genuinely appear in internships and case work, while courses usually stop at "compute an average"; **② more importantly, it supplies a discipline of judgement** — **first ask whether this really is a bandit**. That discipline is especially easy to get wrong in insurance, because **claims experience, renewal and lapse, maintenance scheduling and customer-state transitions all make state evolve over time**, so bolting on a bandit while claiming guarantees is simply incorrect; this project turns that judgement into **an executable check with published exclusions**, which is worth far more than one more algorithm library. Related: demand side in [[choicer]] and [[pricingbandits]]; rate and operations optimisation in [[rate-optimiser]], [[insurance-optimise]] and [[insurance-uplift]]; ESG and climate-retrofit scenarios in [[esg-generator-python]], [[esg]], [[awesome-sustainable-finance]], [[dfa-climate-datasets]] and [[climate-conditioned-cat]]; telematics and behaviour data in [[insurance-telematics]] and [[zenroad-telematics]]; decision modelling in [[imaginator]], [[claims-triage-mcp]] and [[agentic-bop-underwriting]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** at **2 stars and 0 forks** it has no community adoption yet; **②** the README’s Install section says "**PyPI release coming soon**" and requires a source install (`pip install -e ".[dev]"`), while the repository description advertises `pip install bandit-risk` — **the two disagree**, and **the package could not be found on PyPI at this check**; **③** the regret curves and "best arm" values are **the author’s own claims** and were **not reproduced**; **④** the environments are **synthetic decision problems constructed by the author** (e.g. reward distributions with μ = 0.70/0.71), **not real insurer data**. **Verification note**: GitHub repository metadata, the full file tree (43 files) and the README text were all measured through the API; **nothing was installed or run, and the regret results were not reproduced**.
e.body_hk:
**bandit-risk**（GitHub `m-aghababaie/bandit-risk`，MIT，**2026-09-09 仍在推送**）自述為「**為保險與房產智能而做的多臂老虎機算法**」。可核實資訊：**MIT 許可**、**★2、0 fork**、**2026-05-19 建立、2026-09-09 最後推送**、**666 KB**、**Python 3.10+**、帶 CI；結構實測為 **`bandit_risk/agents/`（`epsilon_greedy.py`、`ucb1.py`）+ `bandit_risk/envs/`（`esg_env.py`、`inspection_env.py`、`outreach_env.py`）+ `utils/plotting.py` + `experiments/` + 7 個測試檔**。

**它解決什麼問題**：財產險公司要做**成百上千次重複決策**——**用哪種查勘策略**、**推薦哪項 ESG 改造**、**投哪條觸達渠道**；bandit-risk 把多臂老虎機強化學習用在這些決策上，**從經驗學策略而非用歷史平均**。

**⭐ 最值得記錄的是它對方法適用性的自我審查**：README 用一整節論證——**老虎機要求「獎勵只取決於所採取的動作」**，一旦破壞，問題其實是 **MDP**，regret 保證隨即失效。於是它**對每個環境做此檢驗並主動排除屬於 MDP 的問題**：保留 `InspectionBanditEnv`（5 臂、μ=0.70）與 `ESGBanditEnv`（6 臂、μ=0.71），**剔除**「維保排程」（判為 **MDP**）與「傳感器事件排序」（判為 **POMDP**），並附 `docs/genuine_bandits.md`。結論也有一條真信息：查勘問題上有一個策略明顯最優，**低探索更好**；ESG 問題上前兩名幾乎持平，**探索不足會卡在次優臂**——**正確探索率取決於選項有多難區分**。

對 RIAA：前兩輪補了**需求側**（[[choicer]]、[[pricingbandits]]），本輪補的是**決策側**。實際用處：**①** 查勘/調查/觸達這類「高頻、可觀測反饋」的運營決策是真實場景；**② 更重要的是一套判斷紀律——先問「這到底是不是老虎機」**。保險裡格外容易踩坑：**賠付經驗、續保退保、維修排程都會讓狀態隨時間演化**，此時套用 bandit 並聲稱「保證」是錯的。相關：[[choicer]]、[[pricingbandits]]、[[rate-optimiser]]、[[insurance-optimise]]、[[insurance-uplift]]、[[esg-generator-python]]、[[esg]]、[[awesome-sustainable-finance]]、[[dfa-climate-datasets]]、[[climate-conditioned-cat]]、[[insurance-telematics]]、[[zenroad-telematics]]、[[imaginator]]、[[claims-triage-mcp]]、[[agentic-bop-underwriting]]。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ★2、0 fork**，尚無社區採用；**②** README Install 段寫「**PyPI release coming soon**」、需源碼安裝，而倉庫簡介卻寫 `pip install bandit-risk`——**兩處不一致**，且**本次實測 PyPI 查不到該包**；**③** regret 曲線與「最優臂」數值均為**作者自述**，**未複現**；**④** 環境是**作者構造的合成決策問題**，**並非真實保險公司數據**。**核實說明**：倉庫元數據、完整文件樹（43 個檔案）、README 原文均經 API 實測；**未安裝、未運行**。
